specialty_focus: Al Salam Medical (most notably operating as Al Salam Medical Group in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia) operates, manages, and invests in private healthcare facilities, providing comprehensive multi-specialty inpatient and outpatient medical services rather than manufacturing consumer products. Core Services & Product/Care Categories Inpatient & Outpatient Care: General and specialized medical consultations, major and minor surgeries, and 24/7 emergency (ER) care.
